questions.explanation: He asks her to hold the report until four.

questions.questionText: What will the man do during a break?
questions.explanation: He says he will forward the hotel receipt during the break.

title: Choosing a delivery date for a sofa
audioScript:
Woman: Hello, this is Lakeside Furniture. I'm calling to schedule the delivery of your sofa.
Man: Great. I was hoping for a weekend, because I work during the week.
Woman: We have a truck in your area on Saturday between one and five. Someone needs to be home to sign.
Man: My sister will be there. But the sofa is large. Will the delivery team bring it up to the third floor, or only to the front door?
Woman: Our standard service is to the front door, but for an additional thirty dollars, we'll carry it up and remove the packaging.
Man: I'll pay for that. Please add it to my order.

questions.questionText: Why is the woman calling?
questions.explanation: She says she is calling to schedule the delivery of the sofa.

questions.questionText: What does the man say about Saturday?
questions.explanation: He says his sister will be there to sign.

questions.questionText: What does the man ask the woman to do?

options.text: Add a service to his order

questions.explanation: He agrees to the extra thirty dollars and asks her to add it to his order.

title: A speaker cancels at the last minute
audioScript:
Man: Hannah, I just got an e-mail from Dr. Weiss. She can't give the keynote speech on Thursday because her flight was canceled.
Woman: That's terrible timing. We have two hundred people registered for it.
Man: I know. I called Mr. Abara, who spoke at last year's conference. He says he could do it, but he'd need a few hours to adjust his presentation.
Woman: Then let's put his session in the afternoon, and move the panel discussion to the morning slot.
Man: I'll update the program and tell the printer tonight. We can still get the pages reprinted before the event.
Woman: Please also post the change on the conference Web site.

questions.questionText: What problem do the speakers discuss?

options.text: A Web site is not working.
A speaker is unable to attend.

questions.explanation: He says Dr. Weiss cannot give the keynote because her flight was canceled.

questions.questionText: What do the speakers decide to do?
questions.explanation: They decide to move the panel discussion and put Mr. Abara's session in the afternoon.

questions.questionText: What does the woman ask the man to do?
questions.explanation: She asks him to post the change on the conference Web site.

title: Ordering uniforms for new staff
audioScript:
Woman: Hi, I'm the manager of Bayview Dental. I'd like to order uniforms for six new employees.
Man: Certainly. Do you have the sizes? Also, we can embroider your clinic's name on the pocket for a small extra charge.
Woman: I have the sizes here, and I'd like the embroidery. How long will it take?
Man: Ordinarily two weeks, but because of a holiday, it will be closer to three.
Woman: Hmm, the new employees start in ten days. Is there any way to speed it up?
Man: I can offer rush service, which cuts it to one week. It adds twenty percent to the total.
Woman: That's acceptable. Please go ahead.

questions.questionText: What does the woman want to buy?
questions.explanation: She says she wants to order uniforms for six new employees.

questions.questionText: Why does the woman ask about speeding up the order?
questions.explanation: She says the new employees start in ten days.

questions.questionText: What does the man say about rush service?
questions.explanation: He says it adds twenty percent to the total.

title: Choosing a laptop for field work
audioScript:
Man: I need a laptop for my sales trips. I'm on the road about half the time, so battery life is important.
Woman: Then I'd suggest the Orion 14. It lasts about twelve hours, and it weighs less than a kilogram and a half.
Man: What about the Zenith? A colleague recommended it.
Woman: The Zenith has a larger screen, but the battery only lasts six hours. For travel, I'd say the Orion is the better choice.
Man: Does it come with a warranty?
Woman: Two years, and you can extend it to four for sixty dollars.
Man: I'll take the Orion, and I'll think about the extended warranty.

questions.questionText: What is the man's main concern?
questions.explanation: He says that battery life is important because he is on the road half the time.

questions.questionText: What does the woman say about the Zenith?
questions.explanation: She says the Zenith has a larger screen but a shorter battery life.

questions.questionText: What does the man say he will do?
questions.explanation: He says he will take the Orion.

title: Overbooked training room
audioScript:
Woman: Samuel, I just checked the booking system, and the training room on the second floor is reserved by two groups on Wednesday morning.
Man: Oh no. I made my reservation a month ago. Whose name is on the other one?
Woman: Customer Service. They reserved it last week, but I guess it was a system error that allowed them to.
Man: I can't move my workshop. Fifteen clients are coming from out of town. What about the large meeting room downstairs?
Woman: It has no projector, but I can have one delivered. Would that work?
Man: That would be fine. Please let the Customer Service team know it's their problem to solve.

questions.questionText: What problem does the woman describe?

options.text: A room has been booked twice.

questions.explanation: She says the training room is reserved by two groups on Wednesday morning.

questions.questionText: Why can't the man change his plans?
questions.explanation: He says fifteen clients are coming from out of town.

questions.questionText: What does the woman offer to do?
questions.explanation: She says she can have a projector delivered to the meeting room.

title: Welcoming a new neighbor business
audioScript:
Woman: Good morning! I'm Elena from the flower shop next door. I wanted to welcome you to the neighborhood.
Man: That's very kind. I'm Brian, and this is my first bookstore. We're opening in two weeks.
Woman: Wonderful. Many of my customers are always looking for gifts, so I'd be happy to recommend you. Do you have any events planned?
Man: We're planning a book signing on opening day. I'd like to decorate the entrance, though, and I haven't found a good florist yet.
Woman: Well, that's my specialty. I can give you a discount as a neighbor. Stop by this afternoon and we can choose a few arrangements.
Man: I'll do that. Thank you!

questions.questionText: Who most likely is the woman?
questions.explanation: She introduces herself as being from the flower shop next door.

questions.questionText: What is the man planning for opening day?
questions.explanation: He says they are planning a book signing on opening day.

questions.questionText: What does the woman invite the man to do?
questions.explanation: She tells him to stop by this afternoon to choose arrangements.

title: Complaint about a noisy renovation
audioScript:
Woman: Good afternoon, building management. How can I help you?
Man: Hello, this is Mr. Harris in apartment 4B. The construction in the apartment upstairs starts at seven every morning, and the noise is impossible. I work night shifts, and I can't sleep.
Woman: I'm sorry about that. According to the building rules, work shouldn't begin before nine. I'll contact the contractor today.
Man: That would help. How long will the renovation last?
Woman: The permit says three more weeks. I'll ask them to keep the loudest work for the afternoon, and I'll call you back once I've heard from them.
Man: Thanks. I'd appreciate hearing back before this evening.

questions.questionText: Why is the man calling?
questions.explanation: He says the construction noise at seven in the morning is impossible.

questions.questionText: According to the woman, what do the building rules say?

options.text: Work should not start before nine.

questions.explanation: She says work shouldn't begin before nine.

questions.questionText: What will the woman do first?
questions.explanation: She says she will contact the contractor today.

title: Planning a team-building event
audioScript:
Woman: I've been looking at options for the team-building day in June. A cooking class is popular, and so is the outdoor obstacle course.
Man: The obstacle course is a bit risky for some of our older employees. What about the cooking class?
Woman 2: I think it would be more fun, but the studio only holds twenty, and we have thirty-two people in the department.
Woman: We could split the group into two sessions, one in the morning and one in the afternoon.
Man: Then the other half would be working in the meantime, which would be a problem with the deadline.
Woman 2: Let's ask people which they would prefer. I can create a short online survey this afternoon.

questions.questionText: What are the speakers planning?
questions.explanation: They discuss options for the team-building day in June.

questions.questionText: What is a problem with the cooking class?
questions.explanation: The studio holds twenty while the department has thirty-two people.

questions.questionText: What will the second woman do?
questions.explanation: She says she will create a short online survey this afternoon.

title: Paying a supplier invoice
audioScript:
Man: Hi Olga, I'm looking at the invoice from Northwest Paper. It says thirty days, but I think we negotiated forty-five.
Woman: You're right. I have the contract here. Payment terms are forty-five days from the delivery date.
Man: So we still have until the twentieth of next month. I'll let the supplier know the invoice is wrong.
Woman: Would you also ask them to correct the quantity? We only received nine hundred boxes, not one thousand.
Man: Good catch. I'll request a revised invoice by e-mail. Then I'll attach it to the order file.

questions.questionText: What are the speakers discussing?
questions.explanation: They find that the payment terms and quantity on the invoice are incorrect.

questions.questionText: What does the woman ask the man to do?
questions.explanation: She asks him to have the supplier correct the quantity of boxes.

questions.questionText: What will the man most likely do next?
questions.explanation: He says he will request a revised invoice by e-mail.

title: Checking a tour schedule
audioScript:
Woman: Hi, I'm calling about the walking tour of the old town. Your Web site says it starts at ten, but my confirmation e-mail says ten thirty.
Man: The Web site is correct, I'm afraid. We changed the start time in March because of the heat. I'll send you an updated confirmation.
Woman: Thank you. And is it all right to bring a small child? My son is five.
Man: Children under six can join for free, and we have a stroller-friendly route. The tour lasts two hours, with a short break at a café.
Woman: Perfect. Then I'll see you at ten at the fountain.
Man: Yes. Our guide will be wearing a green jacket.

questions.questionText: Why does the woman call?
questions.explanation: She points out that the Web site and her e-mail show different start times.

questions.questionText: What does the man say about children under six?
questions.explanation: He says children under six can join for free.

questions.questionText: How will the woman recognize the guide?
questions.explanation: The man says the guide will be wearing a green jacket.

title: Changing a gym class schedule
audioScript:
Man: Hi Dana, are you still teaching the Tuesday evening yoga class?
Woman: For now, but attendance has dropped. Only five people came last week.
Man: I think it's the time. Most of our members finish work at six, and the class starts at five thirty.
Woman: That makes sense. Would you be able to move it to seven? I could do that, as long as I'm done by eight.
Man: Seven to eight is fine. I'll update the schedule and the sign at the entrance. You should also announce it in class on Tuesday.
Woman: I'll make sure everyone knows. Thanks for the suggestion.

questions.questionText: What problem does the man describe?

options.text: A membership fee is too high.
Few people are attending a class.

questions.explanation: The woman says only five people came to the yoga class last week.

questions.questionText: What does the man suggest?
questions.explanation: He says the class starts before most members finish work, and they agree to move it to seven.

questions.questionText: What will the woman do on Tuesday?
questions.explanation: The man says she should announce the new time in class on Tuesday.
